_comment: Typefaces the cluster can be retargeted to, all under licences that allow
redistribution (SIL OFL 1.1 / Apache 2.0).  The faces real manufacturers
ship — Monotype's Burlingame and Tipperary, BMW Type Next, Hyundai Sans —
are proprietary and cannot be bundled, so where a family stands in for one
of those the 'note' says whose look it is approximating rather than
claiming to be it.  tools/fetch_fonts.py downloads everything listed here.
'ref' is the family whose cap height defines 1.0 on the optical-size scale;
every other family is scaled to match it so swapping faces keeps the
artwork the same visual size.  See backend/fonts.py.

families.name: Titillium Web
families.note: The cluster's own face. Humanist grotesque, open apertures.

families.name: Inter
families.note: TATA.ev's brand typeface — Tata picked this open family for the EV identity.

families.name: Roboto
families.note: Android Automotive OS default — the face under many OEM clusters.

families.name: Rajdhani
families.note: Indian Type Foundry. Squared technical face; Devanagari + Latin.

families.name: Khand
families.note: Indian Type Foundry. Condensed, tall figures; Devanagari + Latin.

families.name: Teko
families.note: Indian Type Foundry. Very tall and narrow — big numbers in little space.

families.name: IBM Plex Sans
families.note: Closest open stand-in for BMW Type Next — same cool grotesque skeleton.

families.name: Archivo
families.note: Wide apertures at small sizes — the Frutiger/Burlingame school.

families.name: Barlow
families.note: Low-contrast, slightly rounded grotesque; reads well backlit.

families.name: Saira
families.note: Technical face with a width axis; suits wide gauge faces.

families.name: Chakra Petch
families.note: Cut corners and square bowls — the sport-cluster look.

families.name: Exo 2
families.note: Contemporary technical sans with a wide weight range.

families.name: Orbitron
families.note: Geometric display face. The EV/concept-car cliche, and fun on a dial.

families.name: Oxanium
families.note: Angular display face; chamfered corners echo the BMW chevrons.
